items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: (To the question) Before the First Temple, the Nukva was in the third aspect, back to back, of the Mochin of YESHSUT, which are the aspect of the illumination of the head from above downward. And ZA was in the Mochin of the Gadlut of Neshama alone; therefore they are discerned with him only as the aspect of VAK of Gadlut, clothed in his KHB HGT, and his NHY were then found empty of light. Behold, Ima spread in him only the first Hod alone, namely in the old Hod that became Gevura, and in his NHY Ima did not spread. As above. (Item 40).
